cards.card_text: Then Jesus says if your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away.
cards.verse_text: If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell. And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to depart into hell.
